title: Zucchini and Goat's Cheese Patties with Lemony Celery Sauce
subtitle: served with goat's yoghurt
description: Pan-fried zucchini patties with feta and goat's cheese, topped with a hot lemon, garlic and celery dressing and served with goat's yoghurt.

ingredients.name: Mixed Green Leaves (Spinach, Spring Onion, Parsley)

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix the cheeses, grated zucchini, 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped onion, zest of 1 lemon, eggs, flour, chopped greens, salt and pepper until even.
Shape the mixture into flat patties of the size you like.
Heat 1/2 cm of oil in a frying pan and fry the patties for about 3 minutes each side until golden. Drain on paper towel and pour the leftover oil out of the pan.

For the sauce, add the olive oil, 1 lemon (segmented, or zest), 2 sliced garlic cloves, thinly sliced celery stalks, celery leaves and the chilli to the pan and cook over medium heat for about 1 minute until the garlic turns golden.
Pour the hot sauce over the patties and serve immediately with a spoonful of goat's yoghurt.
